Discontinued tables

Prevention and relief live tables, acceptances and decisions live tables, and temporary accommodation live tables listed below have all been discontinued as they were based on data collected via the P1E form which is no longer used. Similarly, Tables 784, 784a, 792, 792a and Detailed local authority level tables have been discontinued as they also used data collected via the P1E form.

In April 2018 the new Homelessness Case Level Information Collection (H-CLIC) replaced the P1E aggregated data return. Tables which use H-CLIC data are listed above.

Added Detailed local authority level tables: January to March 2026, Multiple Disadvantage Detailed Local Authority Data: January to March 2026, Multiple Disadvantage Detailed Local Authority Data: October to December 2025 (revised) and Multiple Disadvantage Detailed Local Authority Data: July to September 2025 (revised).

Updated Statutory homelessness England level time series "live tables" and Detailed local authority level tables: October to December 2025 (revised).

Corrected datafiles uploaded. Corrected financial year 2022-23 dataset: This change corrects figures for households ending prevention and relief duties for  (Tables P4 and R4) who were accommodated from other areas. Corrected April-June 2025 dataset: Household projections values for Tewkesbury have been amended in tables A1, TA1, TA9. Corrected April-June 2021 dataset: Household projections values have been amended in table A1.

We have added Detailed local authority level tables: October-December 2025 data, and updated Statutory homelessness England level time series "live tables" and Detailed local authority level tables: July-September 2025 (revised).

We have also added new prototype accessible table versions for  Detailed local authority level tables: July-September 2025 (revised) and  Detailed local authority level tables: October-December 2025.

We have added Detailed local authority level tables: July-September 2025 data, and updated Statutory homelessness England level time series "live tables" and Detailed local authority level tables: April-June 2025 (revised).
 
We have also corrected an issue with figures for households with children in B&B over 6 weeks (including those pending appeal) within sheets TA1 of our data files from the period April-June 2024. Theses have been updated in Statutory homelessness England level time series "live tables", Detailed local authority level tables: April-June 2024 (revised), Detailed local authority level tables: July-September 2024 (revised), Detailed local authority level tables: October-December 2024 (revised), Detailed local authority level tables: January-March 2025 (revised). Explanatory footnotes have been added to these tables and more information can be found alongside the July-September 2025 written release and technical note.
